prompt_verbatim: Create a single complete pixel-art game animation in-between frame of the same Ultraman Type C shown in references 1 and 2, side view, head to the right. This is the first instant he leaves the monster's back, BETWEEN those poses: keep both arms bent and pulled BACK beside the ribs as in reference 1, with both fists clearly behind the torso and above the belly, NOT hanging under the chest as in reference 2. Slightly open the shoulders and begin lifting the bent hips and feet toward the left, but make the pose very close to reference 1, not yet fully airborne or inverted. The composite reference 3 shows the monster's horns sweeping upward: ensure the character's head, neck, torso and both forearms can clear that horn, but do not draw the monster. Preserve reference 4 identity, short natural torso, silver-red markings and blue chest light. Exactly two connected arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Crisp coherent whole-body 2D pixel sprite, no ground, text, grid or extra objects, transparent background.
